acceptanceCriteria: OutcomeV2 keeps backward-compatible parsing for historical records while every newly generated outcome contains a strict Task Outcome report projection and a repository-bound recovery condition.

The report exposes evidence-bound sections for outcome summary, task overview, delivered changes, findings, risks, warnings, limitations, interventions, forced stops, resolutions, recurrence prevention, avoided impact, residual risks, human decisions, implementation approach, and evidence.

Every non-empty generated report claim carries at least one repository-local evidence reference or is explicitly marked inference; the Runtime never invents a benefit, approval, merge, release, provider, or security claim.

CLI and repository-bound MCP expose the same validated report and localized human handoff; labels and generated summaries switch among English, Simplified Chinese, and Japanese while Contract source text remains unchanged.

A repository-local append-only event stream records findings, warnings, stops, resolutions, confirmations, and completion without silently rewriting prior events; malformed, secret-bearing, cross-Work-Item, and broken relationship events fail closed.

finish writes the validated outcome/report/event artifacts, archive preserves them byte-for-byte and binds them in the archive manifest, and close emits a repository-bound final human report without changing governance authority.

Report generation and validation are covered by Rust protocol, repository, CLI, and MCP regression tests, including malformed, missing, foreign Work Item, stale binding, event relationship, archive, and close cases.

Reference parity and feature documentation in English, Simplified Chinese, and Japanese describe the report boundary, evidence claim rules, event lifecycle, and the fact that second-stack adopter/provider assurance remains external or deferred.
goal: Provide a readable, validated Task Outcome projection and auditable report artifact lifecycle for CLI and MCP without turning presentation into governance authority.
intent: Add a deterministic evidence-bound Task Outcome and Human Benefit projection, append-only event source, and finish/archive/close report artifacts while preserving historical bytes and human-owned decisions.
outOfScope: adopter capability manifest and second-technology-stack acceptance
